resources.string: The console\'s default: %1$d mA, about %2$s W into the battery.
%1$d mA, about %2$s W. Slower than the default: cooler, and easier on the battery.
%1$d mA, about %2$s W. Faster than the default: needs a charger that gives at least %3$s A (%4$s W).

Charging at %1$d mA (about %2$s W into the battery) makes the battery and the console warmer, and the battery wears out sooner. The charger has to give at least %3$s A (%4$s W). With a weaker charger, a computer\'s USB port or a thin cable, charging can stop and start, or the console can run out of power. At the highest speeds, a heat sink on the power chip (RK817) is a good idea. Only use it with a good charger, and not while the console is hot.
